notes: **13 new caption styles of our own** (Clients → Caption style, with a Sample button for each): neon glow, marker, spring up, typewriter, hollow, ribbon, slide up, focus in, impact, stack, sticker, subtle and icon pops (an icon pops above the key words). 18 in all

**Emphasis words:** the AI (or the rules, without AI) picks the words a viewer should feel (the number, the promise, the payoff) and every style colours them. Set your own colour with captions: keyword_color
**Safe zones for vertical video:** captions sit above the platform's caption and buttons and clear of the side column

**Smart punch-ins:** besides tight/wide at every cut, the shot punches in on each emphasis word and cuts back out at the end of the phrase. Markers in the Premiere XML show each one. New clients get it; switch any client with punch_ins: pattern: smart

**AI dubbing** (a finished video → More → Dub into another language): translated by the AI (or paste your own translation), voiced by AutoCut's own built-in voice for that language (never a copy of the speaker's voice), each line fitted to its moment. You get translated captions in the client's style, an SRT, a Premiere XML with the dub on A1 (music and effects kept) and a preview. Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi and English. Labelled as AI everywhere; label it when you post. Also `autocut dub` and the MCP connector (dub_video)

**Teleprompter recorder:** Short form edits → "Record with the teleprompter". The script scrolls over your webcam, record in the browser, and the take goes straight into the queue with the effects you picked
AutoCut's voice downloads once (about 340 MB) from the Dub window or with `autocut voice-setup`
